# G29 protocol vectors: identification flags and every HID report for every legal input.
# Frozen from the legacy C# implementation by tools/G29.Reference (reference.ps1).
# Do not edit by hand. These vectors are the oracle for the Brainfuck port.
# identify <PID hex> <revision hex> <flags>   flags bit0 native, bit1 configurable G29 hardware, bit2 PS4 mode
# <command> [argument] <report hex> [report hex]   each report is the 7-byte payload
